# Disengage [Action]

*[Rules Glossary](../../index.md) > [Combat > Actions](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#DisengageAction)*

If you take the Disengage action, your movement doesn't provoke [Opportunity Attacks](../Attacks/Opportunity-Attacks.md) for the rest of the current turn.
